messages.subject: Renewables & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Simon,

Executive Integrity's retained search work across renewable energy, LNG infrastructure and sustainable infrastructure is strongly relevant to my leadership background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where infrastructure growth requires trusted public-sector, regulatory and stakeholder relationships. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
